caption: A heavy door is slammed shut, and a picture frame on the nearby wall swings from side to side before hanging still.

sa.check: A door and a picture frame on a nearby wall are present.
The frame swings from side to side afterwards.
The frame hangs on the wall rather than standing on a surface.
The order is slam, swing, still.

pc.expect: The frame hangs still until the slam, starts swinging at the slam, and does not start again by itself.
pc.fail: The frame swings before the door moves; or starts long after the door has shut with nothing else happening; or starts again after coming to rest.

pc.expect: The swings shrink: each is smaller than the one before, until the frame hangs still.
pc.fail: The swings grow; or stay the same size for the whole clip; or the frame stops dead at the end of a large swing.

pc.expect: The frame swings about its hanging point, staying on the wall, moving side to side in an arc.
pc.fail: The frame slides along the wall; or rotates fully; or jumps between positions.

pc.expect: The frame stays rigid, the wall does not deform, and the door stays a rigid slab as it slams.
pc.fail: The frame bends; or the wall ripples at the slam; or the door flexes like rubber.

pc.expect: One frame and one door; the frame stays on the wall and does not pass into it; nothing appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: The frame passes into the wall; or falls off and is then back on the wall; or a second frame appears; or the picture inside the frame vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The picture inside the frame, the wall and the door stay the same.
pc.fail: The picture changes; or the wall colour changes; or the door changes design.
